title: Headphone stand
description: A one-piece headphone stand printed upright in PETG without supports: a slim lofted column flaring into a wide saddle curved like a headband, a swept cable hook, and a round base weighted by an embedded steel disc.
process: FDM printing, PETG, pause to embed a steel disc

difficulty.rationale: A ten-section loft driven by coupled formulas, fillets on lofted faces, a four-segment sweep, stability outputs and three kernel limits worked around.

standards: 2012 US Army anthropometric survey, head breadth (Gordon et al. 2014)

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 11 assertions, also at the four corners of the range; stand 609.2 g, disc 493.2 g, tilt 30.84 deg as modelled and 22.20 deg worst case, base volume 178 722.1 mm3, a 3MF of 43 880 triangles, all equal to this example's; 155 script steps plus about 25 runs; nothing refused.
